title: Catalog entries discovered
description: A tooling report brought MCP servers, tools or models that the catalog did not have (RFC-0002, section 9; plan P1-16, step 2). Each is discovered, so it stays denied until the advisory committee approves it (CORE-10). Entries are named by their keys and the SHA-256 of their references, never by a reference in clear, a description or a schema (NFR-20, CORE-11). The agent's own tools (agent/<name>) are entries of the agent the event names. An event lists at most 100 entries: a report that brings more records several.

agent_id.description: The agent whose report brought the entries.

reference_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the string form of the entry's reference (contracts, section 4.10).
